title: Kupcinet-Getz International Summer Program
about: Weizmann Institute summer research program for international undergraduates, placed in host labs for 16 June-12 August 2027. The online application opens 20 December 2026 and closes 20 January 2027; applicants list up to five research topics.
requirements: Complete application by the deadline (CV, transcripts, recommendation letters, motivation letter)
Applicants choose up to five research topics for lab matching
card_alt: Card for the Kupcinet-Getz International Summer Program at the Weizmann Institute of Science, Israel, with an application deadline of 20 January 2027. The photo is the generic default image, an aerial sunset view of a riverside city skyline with a tall tower (it is not a landmark in Israel).
